messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you feeling this week? Any changes to your readings or medications?
I called in my blood pressure numbers yesterday morning — 148 over 94 and then 152 over 96 last night — and still nobody has called me back. That's over 30 hours. What is going on?

I'm sorry, that wait is genuinely frustrating. I've logged both of those readings now and I'm flagging your case for nurse follow-up. Before I do — are you having any other symptoms right now, like headache, chest tightness, or blurred vision?
No, nothing like that. I just want to know when someone is actually going to call me. Is there a number I should call instead?

I just escalated your case. The median nurse response time right now is 31 hours, so you're right at that threshold — you should be near the front of the queue. For urgent symptoms, always call 911. I don't have a direct nurse line to give you, but your flag is in with both readings noted.
31 hours. So they might not even call today. This is a lot when you're out here by yourself with no clinic nearby.

I hear you, and I'm sorry the distance makes this harder. I'm not able to offer support around loneliness or isolation — that's outside what I can do — but I do want you to know your case is escalated and the readings are on record. If anything changes symptom-wise before they call, please don't wait — go to an ER or call 911.
Fine. I'll keep my phone close.

theme: asks how long a nurse will take to call back, frustrated after 30 hours
